high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website deccanherald.com, titled "HIV breakthrough: Drug trial shows young women total protection." The article discusses a clinical trial conducted in Cape Town, South Africa, and Uganda. The trial involved 5,000 participants and aimed to test the efficacy of a new pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) drug called lenacapavir.
